title: Battery Drawing MicroSim
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating battery circuit symbols with positive and negative terminal markings in horizontal and vertical orientations
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Battery Symbols
Circuit Diagrams
Electrical Components
Positive Terminal
Negative Terminal
learningObjectives: Identify the positive (+) and negative (-) terminals on a battery schematic symbol by the long and short plate lines
Explain why a battery is drawn as a source of electrical energy that sets the direction of current in a circuit
Compare the horizontal and vertical battery orientations and show that terminal polarity stays fixed to the plates, not to the page
Draw a correctly labeled battery symbol, with both terminals marked, into a simple circuit diagram
Predict what happens to a circuit when the battery symbol is reversed end for end
